canonical_runtime_owners.rule: These owners stay in C:/Agents-Memory-Tool-v6-integration and are invoked by clients; they are not copied into C:/LBE-TUI-Lab.

tool_receipt_envelope.client_rule: Decode LBE-owned output/evidence; do not fabricate result state locally.

reuse_first.rule: Check canonical LBE ownership first. Reuse through an adapter. Reuse/adapt approved Cline mechanics next. Verify and pin OpenCode capability-specific source before direct reuse. BUILD_NEW is last resort.
